comment: 7075 aluminium alloy, T6 temper. Density 2.81 g/cm3: Wikipedia '7075 aluminium alloy' (infobox). Hardness 150 HB: typical value of public 7075-T6 datasheets (ASM International / MatWeb; Wikipedia gives 87 HRB), not re-checked here. kc1.1 800 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group N order of magnitude. Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 7075-T6
